plugins.name: Tracker Simulator
plugins.summary: Per-torrent simulator for testing a tracker you operate: announces as stable, human-looking peers with gradually growing counters, optionally moving real data between its own peers on this computer. Off until you turn it on; for trackers you operate or have permission to test.

versions.changelog: New client choice: utorrent (uTorrent 3.6.0), copied from a real announce. The auto mix is unchanged.
